// Ad-hoc verification of the pure layers, run inside the dev container.
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { applyDocumentActions } from '/src/web/src/lib/apply.js';
import { applyUnitAction, unitDescendants, unitName } from '/src/web/src/lib/company.js';
import { validateResponse } from '/src/service/validate.js';
import { systemPrompt } from '/src/service/prompt.js';
import { parseDocument, validateAction } from '/src/schema/index.js';

const doc = JSON.parse(readFileSync('/src/web/src/assets/datasets/workflow-platform-fy26.json', 'utf8'));
const tree = doc.tree;
const company = doc.company;

// ── the fixture the plan's Verification section names ───────────────────────
const kr9 = tree.nodes.find((n) => n.id === 'kr-9');
assert.equal(kr9.owner, 'Field Marketing');
assert.equal(kr9.unitId, 'field-marketing');

// delete the team: node keeps owner text, loses unitId; children move up
const after = applyDocumentActions({ tree, company }, [{ op: 'deleteUnit', id: 'field-marketing' }]);
const kr9b = after.tree.nodes.find((n) => n.id === 'kr-9');
assert.equal(kr9b.owner, 'Field Marketing', 'owner text survives deleteUnit');
assert.equal(kr9b.unitId, null, 'unitId is cleared by deleteUnit');
assert.equal(after.company.units.some((u) => u.id === 'field-marketing'), false);
assert.equal(unitName(after.company, 'field-marketing'), null);
console.log('✔ deleteUnit un-owns nodes and keeps their owner text');

// deleting a parent team reparents its children rather than cascading
const noMarketing = applyUnitAction(company, { op: 'deleteUnit', id: 'marketing' });
assert.equal(noMarketing.units.find((u) => u.id === 'content').parent, 'exec');
assert.equal(noMarketing.units.find((u) => u.id === 'field-marketing').parent, 'exec');
// and the charters that depended on it stop pointing at a ghost
assert.equal(noMarketing.units.find((u) => u.id === 'sales').charter.dependsOn.includes('marketing'), false);
console.log('✔ deleteUnit reparents children and prunes dangling dependsOn');

// ── owner is derived from unitId ────────────────────────────────────────────
const moved = applyDocumentActions({ tree, company }, [{ op: 'edit', id: 'kr-9', fields: { unitId: 'marketing' } }]);
const kr9c = moved.tree.nodes.find((n) => n.id === 'kr-9');
assert.equal(kr9c.unitId, 'marketing');
assert.equal(kr9c.owner, 'Marketing', 'owner is filled in from the team name');
console.log('✔ setting unitId derives owner');

// an explicit owner wins, and a null unitId leaves the text alone
const explicit = applyDocumentActions({ tree, company }, [
  { op: 'edit', id: 'kr-9', fields: { unitId: 'marketing', owner: 'Someone else' } }
]);
assert.equal(explicit.tree.nodes.find((n) => n.id === 'kr-9').owner, 'Someone else');
const cleared = applyDocumentActions({ tree, company }, [{ op: 'edit', id: 'kr-9', fields: { unitId: null } }]);
assert.equal(cleared.tree.nodes.find((n) => n.id === 'kr-9').owner, 'Field Marketing');
console.log('✔ an explicit owner wins; unitId: null keeps the text');

// ── charter merge is shallow, per field ─────────────────────────────────────
const merged = applyUnitAction(company, {
  op: 'editUnit',
  id: 'marketing',
  fields: { charter: { mission: 'New mission.' } }
});
const mk = merged.units.find((u) => u.id === 'marketing');
assert.equal(mk.charter.mission, 'New mission.');
assert.equal(mk.charter.process, company.units.find((u) => u.id === 'marketing').charter.process);
assert.deepEqual(mk.charter.owns, company.units.find((u) => u.id === 'marketing').charter.owns);
console.log('✔ charter edits merge one field at a time');

// ── parent cycles are ignored, as in apply.js ───────────────────────────────
const cyc = applyUnitAction(company, { op: 'editUnit', id: 'marketing', fields: { parent: 'content' } });
assert.equal(cyc.units.find((u) => u.id === 'marketing').parent, 'exec', 'a cycling parent is dropped');
assert.deepEqual([...unitDescendants(company, 'marketing')].sort(), ['content', 'field-marketing']);
console.log('✔ a unit parent that would cycle is ignored');

// ── addUnit ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const added = applyDocumentActions({ tree, company }, [
  { op: 'addUnit', id: 'partnerships', fields: { name: 'Partnerships', parent: 'sales' } }
]);
assert.equal(added.company.units.at(-1).name, 'Partnerships');
assert.equal(added.tree, tree, 'a team op leaves the tree object untouched');
console.log('✔ addUnit adds a team and leaves the tree identical');

// ── every action the UI emits is schema-valid ───────────────────────────────
for (const a of [
  { op: 'editUnit', id: 'marketing', fields: { name: 'Demand Gen' } },
  { op: 'editUnit', id: 'marketing', fields: { parent: null } },
  { op: 'editUnit', id: 'marketing', fields: { charter: { mission: 'x' } } },
  { op: 'editUnit', id: 'marketing', fields: { charter: { owns: ['a', 'b'] } } },
  { op: 'editUnit', id: 'marketing', fields: { charter: { dependsOn: ['product'] } } },
  { op: 'addUnit', id: 'new-team', fields: { name: 'New team', parent: null } },
  { op: 'deleteUnit', id: 'marketing' },
  { op: 'edit', id: 'kr-9', fields: { unitId: 'marketing' } },
  { op: 'edit', id: 'kr-9', fields: { unitId: null } }
]) {
  const out = validateAction(a);
  assert.ok(out.ok, `${JSON.stringify(a)} → ${out.errors?.join('; ')}`);
}
console.log('✔ every action the panels emit validates against the schema');

// ── the service's referential filter ────────────────────────────────────────
const filtered = validateResponse(tree, company, {
  reply: 'ok',
  highlight: ['kr-9'],
  actions: [
    { op: 'edit', id: 'kr-9', fields: { unitId: 'no-such-team' } }, // dropped field → no usable fields
    { op: 'edit', id: 'kr-9', fields: { unitId: 'content', metric: 'roundtables' } }, // unitId kept
    { op: 'editUnit', id: 'ghost', fields: { name: 'Ghost' } }, // dropped
    { op: 'editUnit', id: 'marketing', fields: { parent: 'content' } }, // cycle → dropped field
    { op: 'editUnit', id: 'sales', fields: { charter: { dependsOn: ['engineering', 'ghost'] } } },
    { op: 'addUnit', id: 'marketing', fields: { name: 'Dupe' } }, // id taken → dropped
    { op: 'addUnit', id: 'partnerships', fields: { name: 'Partnerships', parent: 'sales' } },
    { op: 'editUnit', id: 'partnerships', fields: { name: 'Partner Team' } }, // known from the add above
    { op: 'deleteUnit', id: 'ghost' }
  ]
});
const ops = filtered.actions.map((a) => `${a.op}:${a.id}`);
assert.deepEqual(ops, [
  'edit:kr-9',
  'editUnit:sales',
  'addUnit:partnerships',
  'editUnit:partnerships'
], JSON.stringify(ops));
assert.deepEqual(filtered.actions[1].fields.charter.dependsOn, ['engineering']);
assert.equal(filtered.actions[0].fields.unitId, 'content');
assert.equal(filtered.dropped.length, 6, JSON.stringify(filtered.dropped.map((d) => d.reason)));
console.log('✔ validateResponse filters unknown teams, dupes, cycles and dangling dependsOn');
console.log('   dropped:', filtered.dropped.map((d) => d.reason).join(' | '));

// ── the prompt ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const prompt = systemPrompt(tree, company, 'kr-9');
assert.ok(prompt.includes('<teams>'), 'no <teams> block');
assert.ok(prompt.includes('"field-marketing"'), 'team ids are not quoted in the block');
assert.ok(prompt.includes('"op": "editUnit"'), 'editUnit is not documented');
assert.ok(prompt.includes('"op": "deleteUnit"'));
assert.ok(prompt.includes('"op": "addUnit"'));
assert.ok(prompt.includes('`owner` is display text'));
const noTeams = systemPrompt(tree, null, null);
assert.equal(noTeams.includes('<teams>'), false, 'a document without an org still gets a teams block');
console.log(`✔ prompt carries the teams block (${prompt.length} chars vs ${noTeams.length} without)`);

// ── the export path round-trips through the schema ──────────────────────────
const exported = { schemaVersion: 1, meta: { exportedAt: new Date().toISOString() }, company: after.company, tree: after.tree };
const parsed = parseDocument(exported);
assert.ok(parsed.ok, parsed.errors?.join('; '));
assert.deepEqual(parsed.warnings, [], parsed.warnings.join('; '));
console.log('✔ a document with a team deleted still parses with zero warnings');

console.log('\nall checks passed');

## Completion notes

- **Planned vs. actual.** All six phases landed as written. The schema half went in unchanged:

  request, `checkCompanySemantics` / `checkOwnership`, and the eight fixtures. Phases 2–6 landed
  as designed too — `web/src/lib/company.js`, `applyDocumentActions`, the `panel` slot,
  `TeamList` / `TeamEditor`, the Detail team picker, and `three-spritetext` labels. What moved
  was every `file:line` citation: all three predecessors shipped after this plan was written, so
  the App.svelte line numbers in Phases 2–6 were stale by 100+ lines and `tree.js` no longer
  exists. The citations were re-verified against the tree before each edit; the schema ones
  (Phase 1) were still accurate apart from `okr-node.schema.json:38-42`, which names `target`,
  not `owner`.
- **Mid-flight adjustments.** (1) `company` went into all three datasets, not just the two the
  plan names — `regional-clinic-network` shipped with `BUNDLED_DATASETS` after this plan was
  written, and leaving it team-less would have made the Teams panel empty for a third of the
  picker. (2) The charter textareas commit on blur and revert on Escape, but Enter inserts a

git branch --show-current && git commit -q -F - <<'EOF'
Model teams with a charter, reference them from nodes, edit them in a panel

Implements Plans/development/TEAM_MODEL_AND_EDITOR.md, all six phases.

Schema (additive, SCHEMA_VERSION stays 1): CompanyUnit gains an optional
`charter` (mission, process, owns[], dependsOn[]) written for a prompt, as the
concept doc argues; OkrNode gains `unitId`, with `owner` demoted to derived
display text; Action grows three branches (editUnit, addUnit, deleteUnit) so a
team edit is the same kind of thing as a node edit; ChatRequest carries
`company`. Two new relational checks, checkCompanySemantics and checkOwnership
— the second warns and never errors, because a tree mid-edit may dangle.

Web: a new pure lib/company.js beside apply.js, and applyDocumentActions()
joining the two halves so `owner` is filled in from the team whenever `unitId`
changes and deleteUnit un-owns nodes rather than deleting them. App holds
`company` in state; it rides in every snapshot, undo, reset, import and dataset
switch, and every team mutation goes through the one commit() path, so a
charter rewrite is one undo step and one history entry. A single `panel` slot
replaces "Detail is open iff a node is selected": TeamList, TeamEditor and
Detail share it. Detail's owner field becomes a team picker (falling back to
free text when the document has no org) and a link in read mode. Team names
render under the spheres behind a legend toggle, off by default.

Service: `company` is validated, described to the model in a <teams> block, and
used to filter unknown team references out of the model's actions the same way
unknown node ids already were. Measured input-token cost of the block on the
default dataset: +1,470 (8,751 -> 10,221), inside the plan's estimate.

All three bundled datasets ship a chartered org and a unitId on every node —
the plan named two, but regional-clinic-network landed after it was written.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF

Committed on team-model-and-editor (ce07098), working tree clean.

What landed

Schema (schema/, additive, SCHEMA_VERSION stays 1): charter on CompanyUnit (mission/process/owns/dependsOn, TeamCharter), unitId on OkrNode, unitId in editableFields/addFields, three new Action branches (editUnit/addUnit/deleteUnit) wired through VALIDATORS, ACTION_BRANCHES, index.d.ts; company on ChatRequest; new checkCompanySemantics() and checkOwnership() called from parseDocument. 8 new fixtures + 17 new semantics tests.

Web: new lib/company.js (applyUnitAction, unitDescendants, unitName), applyDocumentActions() in apply.js, company in App state/snapshot()/undo/reset/import/switchDataset/export/chat body, the panel slot, new TeamList.svelte + TeamEditor.svelte, Detail's owner → team picker + read-mode link, three-spritetext labels behind a legend toggle. All three datasets got a chartered org and unitId on every node.

Service: company validated (400 on org errors), a <teams> block in the prompt, three unit ops documented, and validateResponse(tree, company, input) filtering unknown teams, duplicate ids, unit cycles and dangling dependsOn.

Verification actually run

  • npm run build:schema + npm run test:schema → 113/113 pass. dist/types.d.ts declares TeamCharter once; respond-input.json carries all seven op branches.
  • A throwaway node script against the real dataset: deleteUnit keeps owner text and nulls unitId, reparents children, prunes dependsOn; unitId derives owner; charter merge is per-field; unit cycles ignored; every action the panels emit validates.
  • Service, real model replies (there is a working API key, contrary to the brief — nothing was stubbed): broken unit parent → 400 {"/units/0/parent: "plat" points at missing parent "ghost""}; unknown charter field → 400 from the schema; "what does Marketing own?" → charter-based answer, highlight = Marketing's 6 nodes; "move the industry events KR to the Content team" → {"op":"edit","id":"kr-9","fields":{"unitId":"content"}} with no owner; "make Sales depend on Engineering" → editUnit with charter.dependsOn. Token log: 8,751in without company → 10,221in with (+1,470, inside the plan's +1–2k estimate).
  • Browser at :5173: Teams (17) list as an indented org tree with owned counts; add → rename → mission → reparent = 4 separate undo steps, ⌘Z walked all four back; the captured export blob showed company (18 units) and 4 actor:"user" changes with addUnit/editUnit; deleting Field Marketing left kr-9 with owner:"Field Marketing", unitId:null and Detail showing plain text, and undo restored the link; the team picker set kr-9 to Marketing with owner, tooltip and 3D label all agreeing; labels toggle on/off and update on a dataset switch. Console clean after a fresh reload.

Deviations, all in the plan's Completion notes

  1. company added to all three datasets, not the two named — regional-clinic-network shipped after the plan was written.
  2. Charter textareas commit on blur / revert on Escape; Enter inserts a newline rather than committing (process is multi-paragraph). The name input keeps Enter-commits.
  3. deleteUnit also prunes the dead id from other teams' dependsOn (plan only specified reparent + un-own).
  4. A stale team panel falls back to the list via an $effect — needed by the one-slot decision.
  5. onFocusField wired as an optional no-op for CHAT_CONTEXT; the "Interview me about this team" button left to CHAT_TABS_AND_INTERVIEWS, which owns it.
  6. three-spritetext resolved to ^1.10.0 (npm's pick, satisfies the plan's ^1.9).

Things you should know

  • Every file:line citation in Phases 2–6 was stale (predecessors landed after the plan); I re-verified each before editing. Phase 1's were fine except okr-node.schema.json:38-42, which is target, not owner.
  • Adding unitId to the datasets correctly broke document.test.js's round-trip: it built a document from the tree with no company, i.e. 27 ownership warnings. Fixed by carrying the org with the tree.
  • I touched two running processes. The vite server on :5173 was serving a stale dep cache after three-spritetext was installed and could not recover; I forced a clean restart by touching web/vite.config.js (no content change). On :8787 a stale service left by an earlier agent held the port with pre-change schema validators, which was why the user's own node --watch instance was parked unable to bind. I stopped the stale one and started a fresh PORT=8787 node index.js in its place so the app works. I also overwrote /tmp/svc.log in the container (it was that stale instance's log).
  • applyActions in apply.js is now unused by the app — kept exported per the plan, though there are no web tests yet.
  • Team labels are legible near a subtree but small at the default zoomed-out view (fixed sprite height in world units, as the plan specified).
